title: Cloud LAB Act of 2025
last_action: Read twice and referred to the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: Would establish an NSF cloud-laboratory network that generates biological data for AI training and other research. Its implementation plan must build in cybersecurity, biosecurity, and research security, while an advisory board would address misuse safeguards and rigorous cybersecurity across the network.
committee_dynamics: The bill primarily expands federal research capacity, so it is classified as adjacent, but its biosecurity and misuse safeguards make it directly relevant to AI-enabled biological-risk governance.
advance_rationale: The bipartisan proposal has a concrete pilot design but had not advanced beyond committee referral.
verification_level: Bill details and introduced text checked against official congressional sources.
